run_asr_pipeline: run the AsrPipeline to transcribe an audio file using Whisper and produce a DoclingDocument with conversation text
build_conversation_item: build a _ConversationItem with text, start_time, end_time, speaker info, and optional word-level timestamps
transcribe_audio_file: transcribe an audio file using _NativeWhisperModel and return a list of _ConversationItem objects with timing data
get_default_pipeline_options: get default AsrPipelineOptions for the AsrPipeline class to configure ASR conversion settings
check_backend_supported: check if a document backend is supported by the AsrPipeline by verifying it is a NoOpBackend instance
